items.title: BISEH HYDERABAD CLASS X RESULT
items.description:
Class X – SSC-II Annual Examination Result 2026

Government High School (Campus) Saeedpur proudly announces the SSC-II Annual Examination Result 2026. A total of 124 students appeared in the result record, with 117 students passing successfully. The overall pass percentage is 94.35%. The highest score is 924 marks, achieved by Seat No. 149347 with Grade A1.

Congratulations to all successful students. We wish them continued success in their future academic journey.
